title: silene cretica subsp. annulata
intro: Silene cretica subsp. annulata, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the carnation family, is a subspecies of Silene cretica. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene cretica subsp. annulata are attributed to its ability to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and exhibit analgesic and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
